verdict.rationale: USPTO runs online filing and status-tracking services and has an API endpoint, so outbound event webhooks (for example, application status changes) are a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence documents registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. Docketing, in-portal tracking and an authenticated API are adjacent capabilities, not event subscriptions via webhooks.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
